title: Integrated Harness detailed design spec
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The one-piece Integrated Harness (belt + shoulders sewn together) has design rules in concepts.md but no detailed spec. Depends on: ridebelt-design-001, ridebelt-fto-004 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write a detailed spec: strap layout, sewn joint design and rating, shoulder and sternum geometry clear of the neck zone, adjusters (strap-length buckles, not a vest height adjuster), sizes and bill of materials.
acceptanceCriteria: Complies with every FTO constraint in concepts.md and fto-004 output
Neck-zone clearance shown for the smallest and largest sizes
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
